columns.Location: Office city where the department is based.

columns.HireDate: Date the employee was hired, ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
columns.ManagerID: The employee's manager (self-reference to Employees.EmployeeID); NULL for top-level leaders.

columns.State: Two-letter US state code, e.g. 'CA' for California, 'NY' for New York.
columns.CreatedAt: Date the customer account was created, ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

Orders.description: Customer orders. EmployeeID is the sales rep who handled the order.

columns.OrderDate: Date the order was placed, ISO text 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
columns.TotalAmount: Order total in USD (sum of its OrderItems).

columns.UnitPrice: Price per unit at the time of the order, in USD.
